independence_evidence: A Montreal-based literary journal run by its own volunteer masthead and funded by arts-council grants and sales (Canada Council for the Arts, Conseil des arts de Montréal, ELAN Trellis micro-grant), with no corporate owner (https://www.yolkliterary.ca/masthead, https://www.yolkliterary.ca/).
qualifies_reason: An independent Montreal literary journal that printed Volume 4.2 (Spring 2025), 5.1 (Fall 2025) and 5.2 (Spring 2026), its tenth print issue, on a twice-yearly schedule.
what_it_is: yolk is an English-language literary journal from Montreal printing fiction, poetry, non-fiction, translations and visual art by Canadian and international writers and artists, with an interview in each issue. Print issues appear twice a year in a small 7 by 9 inch format, alongside a rolling online publication and an annual Montreal Fiction Prize. It is for readers and writers of contemporary Canadian literary magazines.
